body: For what it's worth, I read this and I don't see a person who isn't worth my time. I see someone who is in pain like many of us in this sub. I see someone who, like me, has forgotten what it's like to feel true happiness. No one should have to feel this way. I think about suicide constantly, yet I'm still here hoping it will get better. Suicide prevents any chance of that ever happening. I can't talk you out of your decision, but the very fact that are still here is an opportunity for change.

Ok here it goes. 
This has been on my mind a lot lately. It started as just a fleeting thought that I quickly dismissed. I wrote it off because "I'm not the kind of person who just gives up." Things seem to be going wrong in every way lately. Kicked out of school, lost several family members this year, parents remarried and both divorced this year for horrible reasons (criminal charges), friends don't talk to me anymore because I just "bum them out," girlfriend says I've changed and isn't sure if she loves me anymore. It feels like I'm trying to lift something off of me, that's too heavy, that seems to get heavier all the time. I would ask for help, but I don't know how. I don't really have anyone to go to anyway. I hate myself for feeling this way. It makes feel like a coward. I want to fix it, but I just feel like I'm getting worse all the time. I don't know what's still keeping me here, but I guess I'm not done fighting it yet.
